message: Desk 0.1.41 fixes the Create R/O label that sometimes lost the car model or the last name after working for a while. Desk now waits for the model from the moment Create succeeds (not from the click), remembers the last name and model the form showed, no longer lets the next row or a button supply a field, and always prints in the end. The label still reads {LastName} - {Model}, a license plate, plate state, VIN or account number is never the model, and the layout is unchanged.
chromiumMessage: Click Download update, unzip Black.Forest.Desk-chromium.zip over your Desk folder, then press Reload Desk.
